name: Outro to intro at full volume
lesson:
## Both faders up, one bass at a time

A is in its outro; B's intro starts on the one with its low cut. B's fader goes straight to full in 2 bars and both channels sit at full for 22 bars. The bass swaps in a single bar at bar 17, and A's fader only leaves over bars 25 to 33, well after B owns the mix.

House tracks are built for this: outros and intros are stripped to drums so they stack without clashing. The scorer holds you to two faders at full; the only thing that stops it becoming mud is the low EQ, which is why the swap is the one precise move in an otherwise lazy transition.
